name: EPIC 206265026

text.card: A red giant 3,016 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.87 solar masses and 7.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,782 K at its surface.
